Name: SV Mouse Tweaks
Author: ayushua
Description:
[b][size=5]SV Mouse Tweaks｜星露谷鼠标手势[/size][/b]

Move and organize items with fewer clicks: chest sweeps, wheel transfers, inventory distribution, double-click collection, and an optional reserve to leave items behind. Inspired by Minecraft Mouse Tweaks; independently designed and implemented for Stardew Valley.
让箱子转移和背包整理少点几下：扫过转移、滚轮取放、拖动均分、双击聚拢，还能在取出时预留物品。操作灵感来自Minecraft Mouse Tweaks，为Stardew Valley独立设计与实现。

[b][size=4]Chest controls | 箱子操作[/size][/b]
Open a chest and start from either the chest or player inventory side.
打开箱子后，从箱子或背包一侧开始操作，两侧均支持：

• Left-drag: transfer items that can stack with the item you started on.
  左键按住并扫过：转移与起手物品可堆叠的同类。
[img width=381]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55973/55973-1795513031-115808260.gif[/img]
• Shift + left-drag: transfer each item you sweep over, including tools and trinkets.
  Shift＋左键扫过：转移经过的各类物品，包括工具和饰品。
[img width=388]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55973/55973-1795512981-1290302719.gif[/img]
• Ctrl + Shift + left-click: transfer all stack-compatible items from the source side.
  Ctrl＋Shift＋左键单击：转移来源一侧的全部可堆叠同类。
[img width=390]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55973/55973-1795513043-1586733149.gif[/img]
• Scroll down: send the hovered item to the other side. Scroll up: pull matching items from the other side.
  滚轮向下：将悬停物品送到另一侧；向上：从另一侧拉取同类。
• Wheel amounts default to 1, 10 with Shift, or 100 with Ctrl + Shift.
  每格滚轮默认转移1个，按Shift为10个，Ctrl＋Shift为100个。
[img width=390]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55973/55973-1795513052-304049689.gif[/img]

Plain left-drag does not sweep up multiple matching nonstackable items; use Shift + left-drag to move them one by one.
普通左拖不会连续转移多件同款不可堆叠物品；要逐件扫过工具、戒指等，请使用Shift＋左拖。

Emptied chest slots stay in place while dragging and compact after release. Transfers use available space and leave the rest at the source. Emptying the hovered stack with the wheel stops that action instead of taking the item that moves into its slot.
按住拖动时，箱子取空的格子保留空位，松开后才补位，避免后面的物品意外被扫走。目标空间不足时尽量转移，余量留在原处。滚空悬停堆后会停止，不会接着转移补位物品。

[b][size=4]Standalone inventory controls | 独立背包手势[/size][/b]
Open your inventory with E and pick up a stack:
按E打开背包，先拿起一组物品：

• Left-drag over slots to preview an even distribution; release to apply it. Existing stacks receive equal additions.
  左键拖过格子：预览均分，松开后分配；已有同类堆叠只均分追加量。
• Right-drag to place one item per valid slot, once per slot per drag.
  右键拖过格子：每个经过的有效格放1个，同次拖动回扫不重复放。
• Quickly click the same slot again after picking up a stack to collect matching items into one held stack, up to its stack limit.
  拿起后快速再次点击同一格：聚拢背包同类，最多填满手持的一组。

[img width=438]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55973/55973-1795513064-282038736.gif[/img]

Leftovers stay on the cursor. These controls apply to the standalone inventory page, not the chest screen.
余数及放不下的物品继续留在鼠标上。这些手势仅用于独立背包页，不用于箱子界面。

[b][size=4]Reserve mode | 预留模式[/size][/b]
Reserve is [b]off by default[/b]. Click the tray button beside a chest to enable it. A gold border and number show the active reserve; an empty tray means off. N defaults to 1 and can be set from 1–99.
预留[b]默认关闭[/b]。点击箱子旁的托盘按钮开启，金边和数字N表示正在预留；空托盘表示关闭。N默认为1，可设置为1–99。

The reserve counts matching items [b]across the chest, not per slot[/b]. With 170 wood spread over three slots and N=1, you can take 169.
预留按[b]整只箱子内的同类总量[/b]计算，不是每格留N个。例如170个木头分放在3格，N=1时可取走169个。

[img width=451]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55973/55973-1795513078-1414513383.gif[/img]

• Global mode is the default. Per-chest mode lets you enable each chest separately; new chests start off.
  默认全局共用开关；也可改为每箱独立。单箱模式下新箱子默认关闭，点击按钮单独启用。
• Settings persist, and each mode remembers its own switch state. Pushing a chest preserves its per-chest setting; breaking and replacing it resets that setting.
  状态会记住，两种模式各自保留选择。推动箱子保留单箱设置，破坏、收回重放后重置。
• Reserve limits this mod's withdrawals, not deposits, inventory distribution, or other mods' automated extraction.
  只限制本Mod从箱子取出，不限制存入、背包整理或其他Mod的自动取料。
• Plain left-click, right-click, and Shift + right-click bypass reserve by default. Enable their individual options if you want those clicks to leave N behind too.
  普通左键、右键、Shift＋右键默认不受限制；若想单点也保留最后N个，请在设置中开启对应选项。

By default, only currently stackable items are reserved. To include nonstackable items, turn off “Reserve only stackable items” and enable the categories you want: clothing, hats, footwear, rings, trinkets, furniture, tools, weapons, or other. All category switches default off.
默认仅预留实际可堆叠物品。想预留戒指、工具等，请关闭“仅对可堆叠物品预留”，再勾选服装、帽子、鞋类、戒指、饰品、家具、工具、武器或其他分类；各分类默认关闭。

Nonstackable items share a reserve count without merging. Different saved properties, such as upgrades, enchantments, or trinket seeds, count separately. Items whose state cannot be compared also remain separate.
不可堆叠物品只合计预留，不会被合并。升级、附魔、饰品种子等保存属性不同会分别计数；无法确认同款时也分开预留。

[b][size=4]Install and configure | 安装与设置[/size][/b]
Install SMAPI, extract SVMouseTweaks into Mods, and launch through SMAPI.
安装SMAPI，解压后将SVMouseTweaks文件夹放进Mods，再通过SMAPI启动游戏。

Optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] provides in-game key recording, feature toggles, wheel amounts (1–999 per tier), reversed scrolling, and opposite wheel directions on the inventory and chest sides. Without GMCM, edit the generated config.json.
推荐搭配可选的Generic Mod Config Menu，在游戏内录入快捷键、开关各项功能、修改滚轮三档数量（各1–999）、翻转方向，或设置背包与箱子滚轮方向相反。没有安装GMCM也可编辑首次启动生成的config.json。

English, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, and French are included.
内置支持简体中文、英文、韩语、日语和法语。

[b][size=4]Compatibility | 兼容说明[/size][/b]
[b]Implemented compatibility support | 已实现兼容支持[/b]

• Generic Mod Config Menu: optional in-game settings and native key recording.
  可选游戏内设置菜单及原生按键录入。
• Convenient Inventory: favorite-slot protection, auto-organize coordination after bulk deposits, and its Ctrl + Shift + right-click left intact.
  支持收藏槽保护、批量存入后的自动整理协调，并保留其Ctrl＋Shift＋右键操作。
• Bigger Backpack: reads actual inventory slots; standard chest expansions use actual chest capacity too.
  动态读取实际背包槽位；标准箱子的扩容也按实际容量处理。

[b]Overlapping features not supported together | 明确不支持同时启用的重叠功能[/b]

• PrecisionWheel: wheel transfers. / 滚轮转移。
• Manually Organize Chests: overlapping mouse organization. / 重叠鼠标整理操作。
• Automated Sorting System: continuous transfers. / 连续转移模块。
• Stack Split-style mods: overlapping splitting/distribution. / 重叠拆分、分配操作。

Disable the other mod's corresponding feature. If it cannot be disabled, do not enable that mod alongside this one. Changing bindings alone does not establish compatibility.
请关闭对方对应功能；无法关闭时，不要与本Mod同时启用。更换快捷键不代表底层处理已兼容。

[b][size=4]Scope and platform | 适用范围与平台[/size][/b]
Intended for standard chest and fridge menus. Shipping bins, mini-shipping bins, Junimo chests, and machine menus are excluded. Multiplayer and split-screen are unverified.
主要适用于普通箱子、大箱子和冰箱等标准箱子菜单；不接管出货箱、迷你出货箱、Junimo箱及机器菜单。联机、分屏未验证。

Development environment | 开发验证环境：Windows PC, Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.5.2.
